comment: Luitel is a VERY nice man. However, nice does not equate to a good teacher. Nightly review is not necessary for this class, neither is attendance. You will not get less than a B, but you will also have a VERY VERY weak foundation of Macroeconomics. Class is very frustrating because you can get an A without any real comprehension of economics...

He's a fantastic professor. He deeply cares about his students, and tries to do everything in his power to help them comprehend material.  While doing well in his class is possible, it requires a great deal of reading along with a nightly review of the material.

Honestly, you will get an A. He is extremely kind and a really good guy. No challenge at all. This is actually a bad thing for business majors as macro is an important subject and the foundation for a lot of other courses. Great if you just want to meet the social analysis general requirement.
Hardest thing in this class is staying awake, and you dont even need to do that to get a good grade.
nice guy. accent makes it hard to understand a little bit.  no way you can get lower than a B
